history.summary: A 581 sqft freehold 1BR in D15 East Coast at $1,601 psf — ~12% below the $1,817 project median, with new TEL Marine Terrace MRT 550m away and a respectable 4.87% appreciation. The freehold tenure and East Coast lifestyle pull are strong, tempered by a thin 33-txn series (small boutique) that makes the rate less reliable.
history.rating_rationale: D15 freehold near the new Thomson-East Coast Line (Marine Terrace 550m, opened recently) is a genuinely attractive combination — East Coast has one of Singapore's deepest buyer pools. Asking $1,601 psf is ~12% under the $1,817 median. 4.87% resale-only CAGR beats the OCR baseline and approaches the RCR prior. The main caveat is the 33-transaction series — a small boutique dev, so the rate and liquidity are less certain than the large projects in this batch. Freehold + TEL + below-median entry still tilt it to Buy.
red_flags: Only 33 URA txns — small boutique, appreciation rate less reliable and exit liquidity thinner
Freehold premium may already be partly priced in
catalysts: New TEL Marine Terrace MRT 550m — fresh connectivity upgrade for East Coast
Freehold tenure in D15 with deep, durable buyer demand

history.summary: Freehold 2015 boutique in Telok Kurau (D15) with the cleanest value-plus-catalyst case of the five. Asking $1,601 psf is verifiably ~10% below real recent transactions (avg ~$1,770 psf, range $1,383-$1,906 over 12 months). The Thomson-East Coast Line (Marine Terrace TE27 / Marine Parade TE26) is now operational within ~10 min walk - a dated, decisive catalyst. Reasonable cohort depth (5 cohort txns, 33 appreciation txns) supports the discount.
history.rating_rationale: Verified recent transactions average ~$1,770 psf (6mo $1,831, 12mo $1,724, range $1,383-$1,906); the $1,600.69 asking is a genuine ~10% discount to live comps, aligning with the -26.3% age_adj_premium and -12.3% cohort signal which rests on 5 cohort and 33 appreciation txns - far less thin than the quirk names. D15 is RCR with solid realized forward returns per v3.4, and the TEL stations near East Coast are a confirmed physical catalyst, justifying the higher end of medium confidence. Capped at medium (not high) because 581 sqft small units carry a structurally higher PSF and the cohort is still only 5 deep.
red_flags: 581 sqft is a small unit that structurally trades at higher PSF - judge only against same-size comps, not project pool
psf_cohort_txns=5 is adequate but not deep - the -12.3% cohort discount has moderate, not high, statistical support
catalysts: Thomson-East Coast Line operational: Marine Terrace TE27 / Marine Parade TE26 within ~10 min walk - confirmed, dated connectivity uplift
Freehold in established East Coast/Marine Parade lifestyle belt with strong rental demand

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: appreciation_pct 4.87% (ura_5yr_cagr, 33 txns) is credible but per v3.4 forward-uninformative; the TEL catalyst is the real forward story and the value gap is the robust signal. The 2023-2025 PSF rose $1,711->$1,817 (~6%), consistent with a healthy, not frothy, micro-market.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong rental micro-market: residents cite direct city/Orchard buses, abundant F&B, and the new MRT. A 581 sqft unit at $930k renting ~$3.0-3.3k/mo gives ~3.9-4.3% gross - attractive for a freehold D15 hold.
